optional_features.description: Competition cases and state aid: European Commission merger, antitrust and state-aid cases, UK CMA cases and US FTC and DOJ Antitrust Division actions with append-only stages, parties and decision documents as published, and EU State Aid Transparency Award Module awards; parties and beneficiaries reach ownership entities only through reviewed identity matches, legal acts and related cases are linked by exact citation, and cases for a company or its group, stage history and aid for a beneficiary are answered as of a date with subscription monitors. No outcome prediction, no market-power or aid-compatibility assessment and no legal advice. (Market cannot consume this feature: Corporate Ownership already depends on market.lei, so a Market feature requiring it would be a bundle cycle; Market reaches it through the Corporate Ownership bundle.)
